Introduction

Lovelyz is an eight-member girl group formed by Woollim Entertainment. They held their debut showcase on November 12, 2014 and released their first studio album "Girls' Invasion" on November 17.

On November 1, 2021, Woollim Entertainment announced 7 of the members, except Baby Soul, had chosen not to renew their contracts which expired on November 16. After a three year hiatus, it was announced that Lovelyz would release a new song for their 10th debut anniversary.
